mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%m-%d') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sys_log WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY DATE(created_at) ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_log (user_id, username, type, module, action, ip, detail) VALUES (#{userId}, #{username}, #{type}, #{module}, #{action}, #{ip}, #{detail})
